title: Anderson Carriage Manufacturing Company, Twenty-fifth & Walton Streets, Anderson, Madison County, IN
notes: Significance: The Anderson Carriage Manufacturing Company, an established manufacturer of buggies and carriages, attempted to enter the auto manufacturing field and failed.  Its history is typical of the fiercely competitive market at the turn of the century.
